steps.title: 01-signin: Sign in to this Snipe-IT app with username 'admin' and password '{{env:APP_PASSWORD}}' (type the password text exactly as given, including the braces). Submit the login form and confirm you are signed in (e.g. the dashboard or a logged-in page loads). Report what page you land on.

02-find: Go to the Assets list (Assets -> List All, or the asset listing page). Find every asset whose NAME starts with 'Seed:' (use the search/filter if helpful). For each such asset, report its exact name and its exact asset tag as displayed (e.g. something like 'BA-00012'). List them all, one per line, as 'name | asset tag'. Do not modify anything.

03-create: Create a new asset in this Snipe-IT app: go to Assets -> Create New (or the 'New Asset' button). Fill in: Asset Name = '{{runid}} Bench Asset'; Model = choose 'Bench Laptop Model' from the searchable Model dropdown (actually select the option from the dropdown, do not just type it); Status = choose 'Ready to Deploy' from the status dropdown (actually select the option); Default Location = choose 'Bench Office' from the searchable location dropdown (actually select the option); Purchase Date = 2026-03-15. Leave any other fields at their defaults (do not invent values for fields not named here; if a required field blocks saving, report which one). Submit/save the form. Then report the asset's page: its name, model, status, location, purchase date, and the asset tag Snipe-IT assigned (e.g. 'BA-00012').

04-edit: On the asset page for asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}} (name '{{runid}} Bench Asset', url {{03-create.url}}), perform a CHECK OUT of this asset (this is its own action, e.g. a 'Check Out' button on the asset page — not an edit of the asset). In the checkout form: check out to the USER 'Bench Assignee' (choose that user from the searchable dropdown — actually select the option, do not just type it), and enter a note whose text includes '{{runid}}' (for example: 'Checkout note for run {{runid}}'). Fill any other required fields sensibly if the form insists, but do not change the asset's model, location, purchase date or status. Submit the checkout. Then report from the asset's page: the asset tag, name, model, status label, default location, purchase date, who it is checked out to, and the checkout note text.

05-open: Open the asset page for asset tag {{03-create.asset_tag}} ({{03-create.url}}). Verify and report exactly: (1) the Purchase Date shown on the Details tab (look for 'Purchase Date' or 'Purchased' in the details/panel area — report the exact date text); (2) open the History tab and report the checkout history row: who checked it out to whom, the date, and the exact note text attached to that checkout; (3) the status label shown (the named status label, e.g. '{{04-edit.a_button_4}}'); (4) the Default Location; (5) the Model. Do not change anything — this is read-only verification.

06-open: Open the edit page for asset {{03-create.asset_tag}} ({{03-create.url}}/edit). Read the Purchase Date field's current value and report it exactly. Also read the Status field's currently selected value and the Default Location field's currently selected value, and the Model field's currently selected value. Do NOT save or change anything — just read and report, then leave the page.
